question: Who among the following personalities is known as the 'Queen of Carnatic Music'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**MS Subbulakshmi.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **MS Subbulakshmi** is known as the** "Queen of Carnatic Music".**
 
• MS Subbulakshmi was a renowned Indian classical singer who was born in **Madurai, Tamil Nadu** in **1916** and passed away in **2004.**
 
• She was the first musician to be awarded the **Bharat Ratna,** India's highest civilian award, in **1998.**
 
• MS Subbulakshmi was known for her **mellifluous voice** and her contribution to Carnatic music.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kavita Krishnamoorti** is a Bollywood playback singer.

 
 
• She has won **four **consecutive **Filmfare Best Female Playback Singer Awards** from **1995 to 1997**.
 
• In addition, she was awarded the **Padmashri in 2005. **
 
 
 
• **Lata Mangeshkar** is also a Bollywood playback singer.
 
 
• Over the course of an eight-decade career, her contributions to the Indian music industry have earned her honorific titles like** "Queen of Melody," "Nightingale of India,**" and **"Voice of the Millennium."**
